body.x: LG Electronics participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced V30 in raspberry rose color.

LG V30 in raspberry rose is a new red range color with intense saturation that was not previously available. This color is characterized by a passionate deep color sense with excellent attention. LG Electronics has expanded the choice range of LG V30 consumers with five attractive colors that add the raspberry rose to the existing colors, Moroccan blue, cloud silver, aurora black, lavender violet.

LG V30 is the ultimate smartphone with a slim, light premium design, next generation wide angle dual camera that makes it easy for anyone to take professional-quality shots, and luxury sound with tuning of B&O play added on a hi-fi quad DAC. LG V30 raspberry rose is scheduled to release sequentially in the global market starting in Korea in January.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
